Jensen Huang Back as CEO, Wall Street Erupts, NVIDIA Shares Surge More Than 31% | GRAVITAS
Wall Street stocks bounced after last week's bruising losses, with Nvidia rocketing about 33 percent higher as the artificial intelligence company reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO.
Major indices had lost between seven and 10 percent last week in a rout that began with chip companies and extended more broadly.
Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive in a stunning reversal after his dramatic resignation after reports of extramarital affairs including with an alleged Chinese spy.
